headline: Sanderson Farms Championship: Round 1 underway as Hadley and Hossler set early pace
whyCareReason: Defending champion Kevin Yu opens with a 68 as Chesson Hadley and Beau Hossler set the early target on a pristine day in Jackson.
teaser: Thursday 1 October: Round 1 is live in Mississippi. Hadley and Hossler post 6-under 66s; Kevin Yu starts title defense at 4-under 68.
story:
Why this one matters: The PGA Tour's FedExCup Fall burst into action on Thursday morning at the Country Club of Jackson, where pristine Mississippi conditions invited aggressive scoring.

Chesson Hadley and Beau Hossler set the early target in the morning wave, each firing a 6-under 66. Both players capitalized on soft bermudagrass greens, carding seven birdies apiece to share the early clubhouse lead. Defending champion Kevin Yu started his title defense with confidence, holing a 15-foot birdie putt on the 18th to sign for a 4-under 68 alongside playing partner Mackenzie Hughes (69).

With afternoon winds remaining mild, the battle for crucial 2027 tour cards is fully engaged. Players outside the top 125 know that a hot start in Jackson can transform an entire career.
stakes: The winner earns a two-year PGA Tour exemption, entry into the Sentry and PGA Championship, and crucial FedExCup points.
rivalryAngle: High-stakes individual survival: fringe tour members versus seasoned veterans protecting their playing privileges.
